published_ranges._notes: Same official TDS as Prusament PLA: trade name 'Prusament PLA/PLA (Blend)', v1.1 16-02-2022; only line-specific difference printed is diameter tolerance '+/- 0.03 mm for PLA Blend'. Nozzle '210 +/- 10' kept in published_ranges, not fields. Drying 45C 6 h from Prusa KB 'PLA/rPLA' row (Blend not listed separately). Several Blend colours are marked discontinued on prusa3d.com but the line is still sold (e.g. Royal Blue 1kg NFC). Earlier entry: Sold on the Prusament PLA page as '(Blend)' colours; that page prints nozzle '210 +/- 10' (fields = 200-220), bed 40-60, fan 100% with no separate Blend values. The Blend TDS is only published inside a >10 MB zip that could not be read, so density/diameter/HDT/tolerance were left out.
published_ranges._nozzle_temperature: 210 +/- 10 (single printed value with tolerance; not put in fields per rules)

conflicts: filament2print.com reseller page: PLA Blend tolerance 0.04 mm (official TDS says +/-0.03)
